name: ci-hub
description: Companion Intelligence Hub CLI and self-hosted app platform runtime.

scripts.dev: pnpm exec tsx scripts/start.ts up dev --detached
scripts.local: pnpm exec tsx scripts/start.ts up local
scripts.dev:app: dotenv -e .env.dev -e .internal/.env -e .env.local -- env POSTGRES_HOST=localhost RABBITMQ_HOST=localhost NODE_ENV=development turbo run local
scripts.test: turbo test && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm run test:entrypoint
scripts.test:e2e: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && pnpm exec tsx scripts/run-e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:cross-domain: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && E2E_SUITE=cross-domain pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.cross-domain.config.ts
scripts.e2e:future:onboarding: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && E2E_SUITE=future-onboarding pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.future-onboarding.config.ts
scripts.e2e:mcp: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && E2E_SUITE=mcp pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.mcp.config.ts
scripts.e2e:mcp:ci: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && E2E_SUITE=mcp pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.mcp.config.ts --grep-invert "Full OpenClaw install"
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && turbo run tsc && turbo run build && turbo run test
scripts.check:pr: pnpm run lint:ci && pnpm run knip:ci && pnpm run tsc && pnpm run check:openapi && pnpm run test && cargo test --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin ci-os-hub-desktop
scripts.build:desktop: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const command = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'cargo tauri build' : 'pnpm run build'; execSync(command, { cwd: 'packages/desktop', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build:mobile:android: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter mobile android:build
scripts.build:mobile:ios: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter mobile ios:build
